critique: This is now clearly a localized release of dandelion seeds that expands into a broad rightward plume: t1 has a compact source cluster and t4 shows the same material dispersed widely across the right half of the frame. That is a substantial match to the intended blowing-seeds motion, and it avoids the prior full-frame birth field. The result remains somewhat too sparse and faint, however; the t4 plume has large empty gaps and lacks the fuller, more visually legible seed cloud expected from a preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Increase seed density from the same localized emitter so the existing coherent wind-driven plume reads as a fuller, more thumbnail-like dispersal without returning to broad-area spawning.
